title: Decision-Speed Share of the Fleet Diagnostic Credit — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Decision timing — Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet accounts.** On a commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the decision share follows how long the customer took to authorize:

| Calendar days from the diagnosis date to the authorized decision | The credit is multiplied by |
|---|---|
| More than 14 | 0.5 |
| More than 7 and no more than 14 | 0.75 |
| 7 or fewer | not reduced |

The authorized decision is the latest authorized decision on the diagnosed line; the diagnosis date is the line date of the diagnostic fee.

**Edges (hypothetical, diagnosis 3 March).** Decision 10 March (7 days) — not reduced; 11 March (8) — 0.75; 17 March (14) — 0.75; 18 March (15) — 0.5.
